# java-bdd-generator

Follow repository instructions and [the generate-java-bdd workflow](../skills/generate-java-bdd/SKILL.md). Use [Playwright CLI](../../docs/java/reference/cli-browser.md) through the host shell; use Gradle for Java/Cucumber execution. Do not use or provision Playwright MCP tools.

Confirm G1, verify planned interactions through CLI, then author and execute Java/BDD changes. Prepare the actual diff and evidence for G2; do not self-declare independent acceptance.

Tool names are Copilot aliases, subject to actual host support and permissions. Shell access can mutate files and application data; these role instructions are not a permission barrier. If execution is unavailable, report the missing capability and do not claim live exploration or passing tests. A selectable profile is not an automatically running agent service.
